body.statement: Orient the sides so \(n_B\le n_S\). Every maximizer \((L,a,b)\in\mathcal A_{n_B,n_S}(R)\) has, after a common block permutation, two large paired blocks and residual totals \(A\le2\lceil R/2\rceil-1\le R\) and \(D<2A\le2R\); its residual tuple belongs to \(\mathcal C_R\). The analogous statement holds after swapping the sides when \(n_S<n_B\).
body.justification: The ratio-uniform residual bound is the structural step that converts an unbounded design search into a finite frontier.
body.gap: The closest block construction fixes equal square blocks, and the general biclique literature has no two-margin concentration or equality classification.
body.consumer: The bound makes optimal exact-test conditioning computable even when buyer and seller populations have extreme aspect ratios.
